description: Partially update slide copy, slot bindings, layout, styling, or brand settings of an existing Slideshow Run by runId. Call get_slideshow_run first to obtain current revision and slide data. Do NOT use to create new runs (use create_slideshow_run) or delete runs (use delete_slideshow_run). Safe partial patch: unspecified fields are preserved. Requires baseRevision for optimistic concurrency locking; on revision mismatch returns 409 Conflict (no auto-merge), requiring a fresh get_slideshow_run. To patch a single slide, provide pageIndex (0-indexed) with slots, layout, or style. To update entire deck, provide pack. Returns updated SlideshowRun with incremented revision number.

baseRevision.description: Current revision number for optimistic concurrency locking to prevent overwrite races. Must match latest revision from get_slideshow_run.

brandId.description: Updated Brand ID styling reference applied across slides.

decorations.description: Visual decorations list for the specified pageIndex.

layout.description: Layout adjustments for the specified pageIndex.

pack.description: Updated complete content-pack.v1 structure. Overrides entire slide deck when provided.

pageIndex.description: Index of a single slide page to patch (0-indexed). Must be paired with slots, layout, style, or decorations.

runId.description: The unique Slideshow Run identifier to update.

slots.description: Key-value map of slot text/image overrides for the specified pageIndex.

style.description: Style token adjustments for the specified pageIndex.

name: update_slideshow_run
title: Update slideshow run
